mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openchat.contact (uid, room_id) VALUE (#{uid}, #{roomId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id

insert into contact(`room_id`, `uid`, `last_read_msg_id`) values
(#{roomId}, #{uid}, 0)
on DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `id` = `id`
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.uid, c.room_id, c.read_time, r.active_time, COALESCE(c.is_top, 0) AS is_top, c.last_delete_id, c.last_read_msg_id, c.last_hidden_msg_id, c.contact_state, c.create_time, c.update_time, c.version FROM contact c JOIN room r ON r.id = c.room_id WHERE c.uid = #{uid} AND c.contact_state = 0
ORDER BY COALESCE(c.is_top, 0) DESC, r.active_time DESC, r.id DESC
